document_id.description: The document's explicitly printed Document ID. Do not substitute PO ID or case ID.

document_type.description: One of purchase_order, delivery_notice, quotation, other, based on the document's purpose.

po_id.description: The explicitly printed PO ID or Related PO reference. Null when absent.

supplier_id.description: Explicitly printed supplier identifier only; not a guessed company name. Null when absent.

original_delivery.description: The original inbound delivery date, separate from revised or replacement quote arrival. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

revised_delivery.description: The explicitly changed inbound date in a delivery notice only. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

items.description: All visible product rows. product_id, receipt_id (null unless printed), quantity, unit. For a quote, quantity is explicitly offered capacity, not PO quantity.

quote.description: For quotation only: object containing quote_id, supplier_id, product_id, capacity, arrival_date, unit_price, shipping_cost, currency. Null for other document types. Never add these as new top-level extraction keys.

quote_id.description: Explicit printed quote_id only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

supplier_id.description: Explicit printed supplier_id only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

product_id.description: Explicit printed product_id only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

capacity.description: Explicit printed capacity only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

arrival_date.description: Explicit printed arrival_date only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

unit_price.description: Explicit printed unit_price only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

shipping_cost.description: Explicit printed shipping_cost only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

currency.description: Explicit printed currency only. Null if absent. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; amounts decimal strings without currency symbols.

warnings.description: Array of missing, ambiguous or conflicting fact descriptions. Empty only when none are detected.

evidence.description: Array of source_page (1-based), source_field (field path), source_value (exact original text), confidence (null unless actually available). Do not create evidence strings that are not present in the source.

schema.description: Use only visible facts in this document. Missing values must be null; absent items may be empty with a warning. Never infer receipt_id, supplier_id, dates, quantities or prices from another document or from expected answers. Preserve all item rows. Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD, quantities to integers only when unambiguous, amounts to decimal strings without currency symbols. Do not calculate shortage or cost. Preserve source text/page evidence when available.
